name: preventive_screenings
description: Show which preventive screenings a patient is due or overdue for the moment their chart opens, with the last completed date and a one-click order, and let the practice set its own ages, intervals and screenings without a developer.

handlers.description: Puts a protocol card on the chart for every screening the practice tracks
Serves the screening editor and reads/writes the screening rules
Rewrites the cards whose answer changed because the date changed
Shows every applicable screening with its last completed date on chart open
Serves one patient's screening record to the chart-side app

applications.name: Preventive Screenings
applications.description: Configure which preventive screenings the practice tracks, and how often

applications.name: Screening record
applications.description: This patient's preventive screenings, with the date each was last done
